title: Mack's mother sends him to Bud Hopkins

tellings.quote: And so that's how it happened is he ended up talking to Bud Hopkins

plain: Dan Sheehan, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, recounts how a man named John Mack came to meet a man named Budd Hopkins, sometime in the 1980s or 1990s. According to Sheehan, it was Mack's mother who sent him, and that is how Mack ended up talking with Hopkins. He tells it as the origin of how Mack got drawn into the subject of UFOs.
